measurement_caveat: Frozen-baseline comparisons are confounded: its imported shader used runtime JIT compilation, while the candidate and current control used offline Metal compilation (-O2 -ffast-math). Current-control comparisons remain valid. Recorded timings are preserved unchanged; use m5-register-rmsnorm-final.json for matched-compilation-path frozen-baseline evidence.
metal_compiler:
Apple metal version 32023.864 (metalfe-32023.864)
Target: air64-apple-darwin25.2.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /private/var/run/com.apple.security.cryptexd/mnt/com.apple.MobileAsset.MetalToolchain-v17.3.7003.10.GzPOjD/Metal.xctoolchain/usr/metal/current/bin
baseline_method: baseline subprocess exports verified MSL and ABI; exact frozen shader is recompiled and alternated in the current Metal runtime to isolate compiler-generated kernel performance
specialization_caveat: candidate specializes N at compile time and retains a 1024-element row as four registers per thread; both controls use runtime N and BLOCK=256, so gains cannot be attributed solely to register retention

metrics.gpu: Metal command-buffer timestamps; candidate and meTile controls only
metrics.wall: per-invocation synchronized wall latency; compile/setup excluded; includes MLX allocation and graph evaluation

precision_comparison.primary_policy: identical FP16/FP32 storage, FP32 sum-of-squares and normalization, FP32 weight multiply, one final output cast
precision_comparison.primary_mlx_comparator: mx.compile explicit FP32 normalization/weight multiplication before final output cast
precision_comparison.mlx_fast_caveat: mx.fast.rms_norm v0.32.0 rounds normalized input to storage dtype before multiplying weights; FP16 comparison is separately labeled and not identical rounding policy
precision_comparison.reference: seeded NumPy FP32 reduction; meTile/matched-MLX and fast-MLX each checked against their own rounding-boundary reference
